The '''Day of the Hunter Ceremony''' was a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] celebratory event held on [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]]. The pacifist [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Veedo Vaocan]] refused to take part in the ceremony and protested strongly against it.
